label: Defect
definition: An Immaterial Entity that disrupts the continuity of unit cell repetition in a solid substance.; (Elucidation) A Defect is conceptualized to be some region (or a discontinuous aggregate of regions) in a material in direct contact with a crystal, that contains or lacks material entities in a way that disrupts the repeating patterns of a perfect crystal.

label: PhotovoltaicModule
definition: A photovoltaic module is a collection of solar cell circuits sealed in an environmentally protective laminate. Packaging of modules typically includes layering cells between materials such as glass for the front and back, a top and rear encapsulation layer, cells and interconnects, passivation layers and optical coatings, all enclosed in a metal frame. Performance of PV modules are generally rated according to their electrical outputs under standard test conditions. Modules are used in the field together as arrays that make up a power generation site.

label: Solar Panel
definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of one or more photovoltaic (i.e. solar) cells that convert light energy (photons) directly into electricity by means of the photovoltaic effect.

label: Annealing
definition: A heat treatment process that involves heating a material to a specific temperature, holding it at that temperature, and then cooling it at a controlled rate to alter its physical and sometimes chemical properties, typically to reduce hardness, improve ductility, and relieve internal stresses.
